source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.habit: Glabrous creeping perennial rooting at nodes (genus)
morphology_documented.leaves: Peltate leaf blades to about 6 cm diameter with 8–14 shallow lobes; petioles to 35 cm
morphology_documented.flowers: Interrupted inflorescence bearing whorls of 2–15 flowers; tiny white to yellow-green flowers (genus)
morphology_documented.fruit: Flora's var. verticillata: sessile or subsessile fruit, inflorescence often bifurcate; var. triradiata: pedicellate fruit with pedicels 1–10 mm and inflorescence rarely bifurcate

source_scope_note: Genus-level traits are expressly indicated; absent species details not inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: 1999 flora separates varieties verticillata and triradiata; modern treatment may assign triradiata differently; verify before applying diagnostic distinction to contemporary species
preservation: Additive record; original species.json, photos, credits and galleries unchanged
